program = '''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line_color = next(v for v, _ in counts.most_common() if v != background)
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r].count(line_color) > w // 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) > h // 2]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                       grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]]]
            value = corners[0]
            if value == line_color or value == background or any(x != value for x in corners):
                value = background
            out_row.append(value)
        out.append(out_row)
    filled = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(out) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != background]
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in filled)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in filled)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in filled)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in filled)
    return [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in out[r0:r1 + 1]]
'''
